darwin.errorExcerpt:
handshake failed: MCP error -32000: Connection closed
--- stderr (tail) ---
Usage: aegis [options] [command]

Credential isolation for AI agents. Store, guard, and record.

Options:
  -V, --version        output the version number
  -h, --help           display help for command

Commands:
  vault                Manage stored credentials
  gate [options]       Start the Aegis Gate proxy
  agent                Manage agent identities and access
  policy               Manage and validate policy files
  mcp                  Run Aegis as an MCP server
  webhook              Manage webhook alert endpoints
  ledger               View and export audit logs
  user                 Manage users and roles (RBAC)
  config               Manage Aegis configuration
  init [options]       Initialize Aegis — generate master key, config file, and
                       data directory
  key                  Manage the Aegis master key
  doctor               Run health checks on your Aegis installation
  dashboard [options]  Start the Aegis Dashboard (web UI + Gate proxy)
  db                   Database backup and restore
  help [command]       display help for command
